chunks: The sinners will certainly dwell for ever in the torment of Hell.
ai.seo_question: Who are the criminals that will dwell eternally in Hell according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-mujrimun' (the criminals) is often interpreted specifically as the disbelievers and hypocrites who rejected the Imams and the truth of Imam Ali (AS), distinguishing them from general sinners who may eventually be released. This verse underscores the concept of 'Khulud' (eternity) in Hell for those whose disbelief becomes permanent, a key tenet in Shia theology regarding the fate of the disbelievers. It serves as a warning against the persistence in sin that leads to a sealed heart, preventing eventual repentance.
